As a skincare enthusiast who is always on the lookout for great products, I was excited to have the opportunity to finally try Philosophy's Purity One-Step Facial Cleanser for free in exchange for my honest opinion. This product has been around for years and is often considered a skincare classic. The packaging is honestly not my favorite. The plastic feels a bit stiff, making it somewhat difficult to squeeze the bottle to dispense product. However, I've found the cleanser is fluid enough that just holding the bottle upside down is enough to dispense product. I personally enjoy scented products as long as they don't irritate my skin. The scent is somewhat citrusy and herbal, and I find it refreshing. Fortunately, I haven't experienced any skin irritation while I've been using this cleanser. The way I've been using the product is a bit different than some others. Instead of rubbing it in until it lathers, I apply it all over my face similar to a mask and then only gently massage before rinsing thoroughly. I then pat my face dry. This has been my preferred method and seems to be working well for me. My skin feels very clean afterwards as there's a healthy glow remaining. Overall, after using this product for a few weeks, I can confidently say I'll continue to keep it in my cleanser rotation. It has been worked well for my skin and seems to help maintain hydration while throughly cleansing.

this face cleanse works but ikr does t take my mascara off all the way it smells good and it makes my kin so soft i don't get any irritation from it. it's good for its value and it has good ingredients.

Lately, Philosophy Purity Made Simple has become my go-to cleanser for everyday use. Perfect for these warmer days I'm wearing more sunscreen and less makeup. The texture is creamy but lightweight, it foams lightly, and it does a good job removing everyday buildup without being harsh or stripping. 🧼 Highlighted ingredient includes meadowfoam seed oil, which keeps skin rejuvenated and hydrated, preventing the skin from feeling tight or dry after cleansing. The scent is clean and subtle, and not irritating. It's a dependable cleanser that works well when you want something simple, plus it comes in a big bottle so it will be a staple in my routine for the long run! 🧖🏻‍♀️

This cleanser has a perfect consistency that feels great on the skin. Its performance is impressive, as it removes makeup easily, and the subtle scent is very refreshing. Even though it's a premium product, the value is undeniable because it lasts a long time. It also feels light and has quick absorption when rinsed, leaving my face clean and soft.

avis.titre: Pleasant and mild cleanser that is good for most skin
avis.texte: I enjoyed trying out the philosophy purity one-step facial cleanser as I have enjoyed many of their products over the years but never tried this cleanser. It is very mild and has a very nice, light almost lemony scent, possibly from the meadowfoam seed oil. It didn't strip my skin or make it feel dry after using, which I liked. I didn't feel any irritation from it either and it did make my skin feel clean, although not as clean as my primary cleanser. I'm not quite sure how to put it into words, but it may be due to there being actual oils in this as I don't usually use any kind of oils for cleansers. It also is not very good at removing all makeup so I did need to use micellar water for some things. This is a very pleasant cleanser either way and I would recommend it for anyone with normal to sensitive skin.

This facial cleanser from Philosophy is wonderful. It has a creamy texture that instantly lathers up with warm water. It has a very light scent, smells floral to me, but you hardly notice it. It washes away all my makeup, dirt, and greasiness from the day with no problem. It makes my skin feel super clean and fresh afterwards, and so soft and smooth. It doesn't dry out my skin and works great with my combo/sensitive skin type. I've been using this face wash everyday and really enjoy it. I also like how big the bottle is, its going to last me a long time.

My go to gentile face cleanser. I have the most sensitive skin and break out or get a rash to almost anything I put on my skin! This is one of two facial cleansers that work wonders for my skin. It lathers good and gets off all my makeup without stripping and making my face exra dry. It lasts a while as a little goes a long way. I have purchased it many times over and will continue to do so! ❤️

This is a holy grail cleanser for a reason! I absolutely love using it in the shower to remove my makeup and refresh my skin at the end of the day. It's non irritating, doesn't have a strong scent either. Very easy to use and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry. Great product!

avis.titre: Thee BEST face wash out there!
avis.texte: This is seriously the best face wash I've ever used. I wear quite a bit of makeup everyday and this has no problem cleaning it all off. I cleanse twice with this just to be sure. This is powerful enough to get my skin squeaky clean, but also extremely gentle on the skin. This leaves my skin feeling so soft and clean. I also really enjoy the scent. It's very light and smells of herbs. This has easily become an absolute staple in my everyday routine!

Facial cleanser smells really good. But it doesn't have the ingredients needed to help cleanse my face. I wouldn't add it to my daily facial routine cleaning. It even broke my face out after using it for 2 weeks.

I loved Philosophy facial cleanser makes my face feel refreshed and clean. It lathered up just right to wash my face and rinsed off leaving no residue. The eucalyptus scent was a bonus made me feel like I was at the spa.
